adaptations: published rank2 covariance, tau=.5 and signed raw N(1,.9^2) gain; own known random x0, calibration/target inputs, measurement noise and MAP; not figure reproduction
design: prior-averaged local delta-method predictive variance; same available information
failure_policy: retain finite last iterate with failure flag at max_nfev; exceptions/nonfinite responses fall back to nominal mean and are flagged
independent_unit: connection matrix J; other repeats nested
integrator: exact rank-two state reduction; analytic zero-order-held known-input filter; RK4 at dt/2 with stagewise integral of rate and gradients
normalized_missing_policy: complete standardized stratum NA if any prespecified target scale invalid; raw risk retained
primary_interval: 95% paired network-cluster bootstrap; one prespecified primary contrast
primary_metric: mean squared raw q error aggregated within J over truth/noise/target/design repeats
protocol_revision_reason: before any formal N100 effect inspection: Euler numerical audit failed; RK4 sub2 passes; larger prior ensemble chosen due L8/16 selection instability; optimizer cap raised after numerical audit max_nfev40 failures; n6 increased to n8 on timing budget
secondary_comparisons: all other strata and 2x2 interaction exploratory 95% network-cluster intervals
secondary_metric: mean error^2 divided by common independent nonlinear prior-MC q variance
source_scope: independent synthetic simulations; no biological validation or new-method claim
vector_target: same three prespecified readouts; equal raw-response weights
sample_size_reason: 40 new independent networks fixed before outcome inspection (five times the old pilot); feasible precision expansion, no a-priori power guarantee, no outcome-adaptive stopping
